concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset: בחירה — free choice; the central concept of the teaching, stated to be always in a person's hands
הרגל — habit/habituation from youth; presented as the cause of confusion about free choice (eitza-type relationship, not bechina)
analysis_notes.note: This teaching contains no bechina-type identifications. The concepts present (bechira, hergel) are related causally: habit causes the illusion of lacking free choice. This is an eitza relationship, not a bechina. Neither concept reaches the 3-node threshold for a package, and there is no shared-nature cluster to form. The teaching is practical/philosophical rather than conceptual-structural.
